item.title: Version 0.21.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.21.1

Improvements

  • Cleaner Add and Edit Panels: The panels for adding links, spaces, and smart folders, and for sharing a space, now match the app’s design and show each link’s real icon.
  • Sidebar Side Conflict Warning: Preferences now warn when an enabled trigger edge overrides your default sidebar side, with a one-click fix.
  • Clearer Settings Names: Several preference toggles are renamed to plainly say what they do, and the ChatGPT Atlas section appears only when Atlas is installed.
  • Clearer Auto-Show Setting Name: The browser auto-show setting is now called “Auto Show on Browser Focus” for clarity.

Bug Fixes

  • The folder hover preview now scrolls through all links, instead of stopping at the first six.
  • Add and edit panels now stay open when your cursor leaves the sidebar, instead of vanishing.
